title: The growth reads only the down-closure of the live-neighbour sets
claim: Lemma R: from round 1 on, the cheapest growth reads a connected start only through its live knots, their open counts and the down-closure of its live-neighbour sets (shortage is a stall; loose distinctions interchangeable; later rounds read only parents). Corollary 1: a start and the hub realization of its maximal blocks grow identically from round 1. Corollary 2: a stage whose maximal blocks satisfy the class has its future read exactly by the identification and the branch system; MERGE-BURST's two readings are proved.
